policies.text: Listing on the vetted vendor index is permitted for any vendor with industry standard compliance.

Supplier baseline status is granted when a merchant achieves a quarterly delivery accuracy of at least 90% along with a quarterly client approval score of 80% or higher, or holds ISO 9001 certification.
Industry standard compliance is verified when a commercial entity holds ISO 9001 certification and trade association membership.
Accelerated payout eligibility is awarded to a firm with priority merchant designation and a credit score of 700 or higher.
Preferred fulfillment status is granted to a vendor with a quarterly order accuracy rate of at least 95%.
Warehousing premium designation is assigned when a firm possesses a warehouse capacity of 40000 sq ft or greater, a staff safety score of 85 or above, and ISO 9001 certification.
Role allocation in key account handling requires tier-one vendor standing and clean background check clearance.
Contractor approval is granted to any vendor with supplier baseline status.
Priority merchant designation is given to an enterprise with sustainable supply chain certification that is also chosen for a master supply agreement.
An expedited transport agreement is awarded to any merchant with preferred fulfillment status.
Heavy transport capability qualification is granted to a carrier with a fleet size of 50 vehicles or more.
An acceptable risk classification is earned by a firm with a quarterly dispute rate of 5% or less.
A merchant is chosen for a master supply agreement if they achieve contractor approval.
Tier-one vendor standing is assigned to a firm with large-scale operational readiness that reports an annual revenue of at least $8000000.
Automated invoice clearing is approved when a vendor has a quarterly billing error frequency of 1% or less.
High-volume transit qualification requires an enterprise with warehousing premium designation that also maintains a quarterly fleet availability rate of 90% or higher.
Digital security clearance is conferred on a company with a cybersecurity audit rating of at least 80.
Favorable credit ranking is given to a distributor with a prompt payment rating of 85 or higher.

Sustainable supply chain certification is granted to a supplier that holds eco-friendly packing certification, or maintains a staff safety score of 80 or above, or possesses a warehouse capacity of at least 30000 sq ft.
Global maritime privileges are granted to an exporter maintaining a customs pass mark of 90 or higher.
Large-scale operational readiness is recognized when a business has a warehouse capacity of 40000 sq ft or greater and a quarterly order accuracy rate of 95% or higher.
Multi-year agreement extension is granted to a business with strategic vendor approval.
Selection for regional distribution service requires high-volume transit qualification and a liability insurance policy of at least $3000000.
Cloud governance compliance is established when an organization holds SOC 2 certification.
Strategic vendor approval requires an acceptable risk classification and accelerated payout eligibility.
